title: Production approval demo
decision_rule: Classify the named release as APPROVED only when the source explicitly states that it is approved for production deployment. Classify it as REJECTED only when the source explicitly states that it is rejected or blocked for production deployment. Otherwise classify it as UNRESOLVED.
